items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Ray used to tell me about Ron Carter, and I love the simple image. He said, “You see,” he said, “Niels Henning, Oscar Peterson.

ctx.x: I think about that, referring to my other master, Ron Carter, it’s okay you have to play the bass, some people can be like, it’s like on the piano, Oscar Peterson explained that so well. Some people play great music just with a few notes. Count Basie. Oscar, for some reason, he’s got more to say. But the point is that the artistry of someone is not the quantity of the notes, it’s what you say. And for the bass line it’s the same.
